situation: Someone left a note in the guest book that none of the staff remember writing.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh dear, oh dear, I'm so sorry, I should have noticed it sooner. Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Pierce, sit down before you apologize to the furniture. Who wrote the note, and what does it say?

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Nobody writes in my guest book without signing their name, Vex, and this one has no name at all.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, I'm terribly sorry, Madame. I did check the book at midnight, I swear it was blank. Well, nearly blank.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Nearly blank is doing a lot of work there, Pierce. Bring me the book, and then tell me what the note actually says.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: This is a respectable establishment, Pierce, and respectable establishments do not receive anonymous notes. Read it aloud, and do not skip the smudged parts.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, yes, of course, Madame! Right away. I'm so sorry, the smudged part is a bit... well, it says "Room 404 is awake." Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Room 404 is awake, Pierce, which means someone up there has been reading our mail. Pour yourself a drink. Then pour me one.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pour nothing, Vex. Nobody drinks at my desk until we know who is awake in room 404.
